overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for NMBU: all 8 plans have correct, complete and clean sections, with sub-headings kept inside learning outcomes and Obligatorisk aktivitet correctly separated from assessment. Both pre-pass flags are false alarms; the only loss is text under unmapped headings (Laeringsstotte, Undervisningstider, Merknader, Overlapp).

findings.description: Headings Læringsstøtte, Undervisningstider, Merknader and Overlapp are unmapped and their text is not in any section. Undervisningstider holds teaching-format information (e.g. FYS100 lists lecture, exercise and lab hours; PPRA301 says 60 days supervised practice) and Læringsstøtte describes supervision, which arguably belongs in teaching_methods per the codebook. Admission-like headings (Opptakskrav, Fortrinnsrett) are dropped appropriately.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R has no pattern for Læringsstøtte / Undervisningstider, so the blocks are discarded as unmapped.
findings.suggested_fix: Map `Undervisningstider` and `Læringsstøtte` to teaching_methods in R/section_heading_map.R (optionally scoped to NMBU), after checking they do not add logistics noise on other institutions.
